name: @instatic/plugin-public-auth
description: Public-facing user authentication: registration, login, JWT sessions, password reset, email verification. Provides a viewerContext provider for downstream plugins.

instaticManifest.name: Public Authentication
instaticManifest.description: End-user registration, login, password reset, and JWT-based sessions for Instatic sites. Exposes a viewerContext provider.

settings.label: JWT signing secret
settings.description: HMAC secret for signing access tokens. Rotate to invalidate all sessions.

settings.label: Access token TTL (seconds)
settings.description: How long access tokens remain valid. Default 1 hour.

settings.label: Require email verification
settings.description: Block login until the user clicks the verification email.
